profile.name: Daniel de Gois
profile.tagline: I keep time on the kit and build things on the screen: web apps, games and software.
about: I'm Daniel, a drummer and a developer. Most days I split my time between the kit and a code editor, and the two have more in common than people think. Both reward patience, repetition and a good sense of timing.
On the software side I build web applications, games and small tools. I like taking an idea from a rough sketch to something people can actually click on and use.
This site is my home base. Every project I make has a link here, so the Projects tab is the place to see what I've been working on.
profile.drumsIntro: Behind the kit I care about groove first: playing for the song, locking in with the bass and keeping the pocket steady.
profile.codeIntro: I build for the browser first, and I'm always picking up new tools along the way.
